            ESP = {Enabled=true,Boxes=true,Names=false,Health=true,Distance=false,Snaplines=false,ColorEnemy=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200),BoxStyle="Corner",NameSize=13,MaxDistance=300},

            Visual = {FOVCircle=true,FOVCircleColor=Color3.fromRGB(100,200,100),FOVCircleThickness=1,ThirdPerson=false,ThirdPersonDistance=6,NoRecoil=false,NoSpread=false}
        }
    }
    
    local function DeepCopy(tbl)
        local copy = {}
        for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
            if type(v) == "table" then copy[k] = DeepCopy(v) else copy[k] = v end
        end
        return copy
    end
    
    local ActiveProfile = "Default"
    local Settings = DeepCopy(Profiles.Default)
    
    local function LoadProfile(name)
        if not Profiles[name] then return end
        ActiveProfile = name
        Settings = DeepCopy(Profiles[name])
        Settings.Aimbot.LastSnapTime = 0
        Settings.Movement.BhopNextJump = 0
        if IsMobile and Settings.Aimbot.Enabled then HoldingAim = true
        elseif IsMobile then HoldingAim = false end
    end
    
    local HoldingAim = false
    local OriginalSizes = {}
    local ESPObjects = {}
    local GUIVisible = true
    local LastGuiToggle = 0
    
    local function GetEnemyFolder()
        local chars = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not chars then return nil end
        local t = chars:FindFirstChild("Terrorists")
        local ct = chars:FindFirstChild("Counter-Terrorists")
        if not t or not ct then return nil end
        return t:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name) and ct or t
    end
    
    local function IsAlive(c)
        if not c then return false end
        local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return h and h.Health > 0
    end
    
    local function ApplyResolver(pos)
        if not Settings.Aimbot.ResolverEnabled then return pos end
        local mode = Settings.Aimbot.ResolverMode
        if mode == "Static" then
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverYaw))*2, math.tan(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverPitch))*2, math.cos(math.rad(Settings.Aimbot.ResolverYaw))*2)
        elseif mode == "Jitter" then
            local j = math.rad(math.random(-Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange, Settings.Aimbot.ResolverJitterRange)/10)
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(j)*2, 0, math.cos(j)*2)
        elseif mode == "Spin" then
            local a = tick() * Settings.Aimbot.ResolverSpinSpeed
            return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(math.rad(a % 360))*3, 0, math.cos(math.rad(a % 360))*3)
        end
        return pos
    end
    
    local function GetTarget()
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, Settings.Aimbot.FOV
        local center = Camera.ViewportSize/2
        for _, e in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(e) then
                local p = e:FindFirstChild(Settings.Aimbot.AimPart) or e:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if p then
                    local sp, onScr = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(ApplyResolver(p.Position))
                    if onScr and sp.Z > 0 then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = p end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    
    -- ESP Functions
    local function CreateESP(enemy)
        if ESPObjects[enemy] then return end
        ESPObjects[enemy] = {
            Box = Drawing.new("Square"), BoxTL = Drawing.new("Line"), BoxTR = Drawing.new("Line"),
            BoxBL = Drawing.new("Line"), BoxBR = Drawing.new("Line"), Name = Drawing.new("Text"),
            HealthBar = Drawing.new("Square"), HealthBG = Drawing.new("Square"),
            Snapline = Drawing.new("Line"), Distance = Drawing.new("Text")
        }
        local d = ESPObjects[enemy]
        d.Box.Thickness = 1.5; d.Box.Filled = false; d.Box.Visible = false
        for _, c in ipairs({d.BoxTL, d.BoxTR, d.BoxBL, d.BoxBR}) do
            c.Thickness = 2; c.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; c.Visible = false
        end
        d.Name.Size = Settings.ESP.NameSize; d.Name.Center = true; d.Name.Outline = true; d.Name.Visible = false
        d.HealthBar.Filled = true; d.HealthBar.Visible = false
        d.HealthBG.Filled = true; d.HealthBG.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); d.HealthBG.Visible = false
        d.Snapline.Thickness = 1; d.Snapline.Visible = false
        d.Distance.Size = 12; d.Distance.Center = true; d.Distance.Outline = true; d.Distance.Visible = false
    end
    
    local function RemoveESP(enemy)
        local data = ESPObjects[enemy]
        if not data then return end
        for _, v in pairs(data) do pcall(function() v:Remove() end) end
        ESPObjects[enemy] = nil
    end
    
    local function ClearAllESP()
        for enemy in pairs(ESPObjects) do RemoveESP(enemy) end
    end
    
    local function UpdateESP()
        if not Settings.ESP.Enabled then ClearAllESP(); return end
        local enemyFolder = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not enemyFolder then ClearAllESP(); return end
        local active = {}
        for _, enemy in ipairs(enemyFolder:GetChildren()) do
            active[enemy] = true
            if IsAlive(enemy) then
                CreateESP(enemy)
                local data = ESPObjects[enemy]
                local head = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local root = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if head and root and hum then
                    local top, onTop = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0))
                    local bottom = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
                    if onTop and top.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(top.Y - bottom.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.5
                        local x, y = top.X - width / 2, top.Y
                        local cornerLen = width * 0.25
                        if Settings.ESP.BoxStyle == "Full" then
                            data.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height); data.Box.Position = Vector2.new(x, y)
                            data.Box.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Box.Visible = Settings.ESP.Boxes
                            for _, c in ipairs({data.BoxTL, data.BoxTR, data.BoxBL, data.BoxBR}) do c.Visible = false end
                        else
                            data.Box.Visible = false
                            if Settings.ESP.Boxes then
                                data.BoxTL.From = Vector2.new(x, y); data.BoxTL.To = Vector2.new(x + cornerLen, y); data.BoxTL.Visible = true
                                data.BoxTR.From = Vector2.new(x + width, y); data.BoxTR.To = Vector2.new(x + width - cornerLen, y); data.BoxTR.Visible = true
                                data.BoxBL.From = Vector2.new(x, y + height); data.BoxBL.To = Vector2.new(x + cornerLen, y + height); data.BoxBL.Visible = true
                                data.BoxBR.From = Vector2.new(x + width, y + height); data.BoxBR.To = Vector2.new(x + width - cornerLen, y + height); data.BoxBR.Visible = true
                            else
                                for _, c in ipairs({data.BoxTL, data.BoxTR, data.BoxBL, data.BoxBR}) do c.Visible = false end
                            end
                        end
                        if Settings.ESP.Snaplines then
                            local sc = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
                            data.Snapline.From = Vector2.new(sc.X, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                            data.Snapline.To = Vector2.new(top.X, y + height)
                            data.Snapline.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Snapline.Visible = true
                        else data.Snapline.Visible = false end
                        data.Name.Text = enemy.Name; data.Name.Position = Vector2.new(top.X, y - 15)
                        data.Name.Color = Settings.ESP.ColorEnemy; data.Name.Size = Settings.ESP.NameSize; data.Name.Visible = Settings.ESP.Names
                        if Settings.ESP.Distance and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local dist = (root.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                            data.Distance.Text = string.format("%.0fm", dist)
                            data.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(top.X, y + height + 4)
                            data.Distance.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1); data.Distance.Visible = true
                        else data.Distance.Visible = false end
                        if Settings.ESP.Health then
                            local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
                            local barH = height * pct
                            data.HealthBG.Size = Vector2.new(3, height); data.HealthBG.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y); data.HealthBG.Visible = true
                            data.HealthBar.Size = Vector2.new(3, barH); data.HealthBar.Position = Vector2.new(x - 6, y + height - barH)
                            data.HealthBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - pct), 255 * pct, 50); data.HealthBar.Visible = true
                        else data.HealthBar.Visible = false; data.HealthBG.Visible = false end
                    else for _, v in pairs(data) do v.Visible = false end end
                end
            else RemoveESP(enemy) end
        end
        for enemy in pairs(ESPObjects) do if not active[enemy] then RemoveESP(enemy) end end
    end
    
    local function ShootThroughWalls()
        if not Settings.Wallbang.Enabled then return end
        if not IsAlive(LocalPlayer.Character) then return end
        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local ef = GetEnemyFolder()
        if not ef then return end
        for _, enemy in ipairs(ef:GetChildren()) do
            if IsAlive(enemy) then
                local head = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local dist = (head.Position - origin).Magnitude
